name: I Come In Peace
description: I Come In Peace was one of the LAAT/i gunships used to bring wounded clones away from the destroyed Geonosis primary droid foundry Ray Shield Fortress during the Second Battle of Geonosis.

data.name: I Come In Peace
data.model: Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry repulsorlift gunship
armament: Anti-personnel laser turrets (2 at the front)
Composite-beam laser turrets (2 behind the cockpit and 2 others on the wings)
